winners.name: Autonom - Unleashing RWAs in Solana
winners.description:
Apart from Ostium (one standalone perp DEX), RWAs and particularly equities haven’t really hit perps or at least not in Solana. 

Confidence in these assets is weak and thus leverage is low compared to crypto.  Equities go through all kinds of corporate actions (such as splits, dividends, or M&A) which impact share price and this is something which incumbent oracles don’t account for. 
They offer real-time prices but lack the account-based context that can be crucial to a trade. 
As a result, onchain perpetual future derivatives (perps) or lend/borrow applications face a choice: lack confidence, accept manual pricing risk or exclude these assets entirely.

Autonom is a specialized oracle for RWAs, factoring in for corporate action adjustments, enabling dynamic pricing on-chain.  
For perp DEXs, Autonom also has a funding service and a risk a module with recommendations to deleverage or to return to baseline leverage around risk windows.

winners.name: Superfan
winners.description: Superfan is a meta-record label, turning fan belief into artist credit through futarchy curation. Fans own labels through tokens, vote on which artists get funded, and benefit from repayments, built on Solana + MetaDAO infrastructure. Belief-backed credit, now radically democratic.
winners.additionalInfo:
YOU CAN REVIEW THE SOLANA EXTENSION HERE: https://github.com/kevinknielsen/superfan-core/pull/37

The Problem
───────────
Artists need $5k to press vinyl, $10k for studio time, $20k to tour. But banks say no. Labels say yes, then take your masters, your rights, your freedom. Meanwhile, fans already invest emotionally and financially (streams, merch, shows), but their belief never translates into artist purchasing power.

The Solution
────────────
Superfan turns fan belief into spendable credit through two layers of futarchy governance:

Layer 1: DAO Futarchy (MetaDAO Integration)
Community votes on which music labels to fund via prediction markets. If a label proposal passes, Superfan DAO deploys capital (USDC) and mints label governance tokens. Fans who voted "pass" receive tokens; they now own the label.

Token Distribution:
• 50% → Founding curator team
• 40% → Futarchy pass market winners (believers)
• 10% → Superfan DAO (protocol participation)

Layer 2: Label Token Holder Futarchy (Nested Governance)
Artists submit funding proposals to labels. Label token holders (fans who own the label) vote via futarchy on which artists get funded. No curator gatekeeping, the market decides.

Layer 3: Presale Mechanics (Self-Repaying Credit)
Approved artists run tokenized presales (our existing superfan-presale program). Fans back campaigns with USDC, artists use credit for production, and as fans redeem rewards (vinyl, tickets, merch), credit repays itself. Repayments flow to label treasury, increasing value for all token holders.

Why Solana + MetaDAO?
──────────────────────
• Solana: 1000x cheaper transactions ($0.00002 vs $0.02 on Base)
• MetaDAO: Battle-tested futarchy infrastructure (conditional vaults, AMM, TWAP oracles)
• Double Futarchy: DAO level + Label level = fully decentralized curation
• Fan Ownership: Not just backers; actual label owners who govern and benefit

Technical Implementation
────────────────────────
Three Anchor programs:
1. superfan-dao: DAO treasury + label funding futarchy
2. label-subdao: Token holder governance + artist credit lines
3. superfan-presale: USDC escrow + tokenized campaigns

Economics: 95% of repayments stay in label treasury (token value ↑), 5% to Superfan DAO, with 10% protocol fee to MetaDAO.

Impact
──────
This is the first consumer futarchy application. Artists get capital without losing rights. Fans own labels and govern decisions. Belief becomes liquid, transparent, and self-repaying.

winners.name: Kormos
winners.description:
Bringing higher yields without leverage to Solana with a fractional reserves primitive

Kormos vaults allocate user funds across Solana DeFi. Part of the funds deposited by 'liquid depositors' is invested into both liquid (i.e. DeFi lending) and illiquid (i.e. PT assets) protocols - just like banks invest short term deposits into long term loans according to set reserve ratios. That allows Kormos to provide superior yield to its users without taking leverage.

Two depositor types:
 1. Liquid depositors - higher yield (compared to other liquid DeFi yield) with risk of having to wait in a FIFO queue in case of 'bank run' (otherwise - instant redemption)
 2. Locked depositors - higher yield (compared to assets of same maturity), select their redemption period, longer period - higher yield

Deposit protection: locked depositors act as senior tranche towards liquid depositors, they take the first hit in case of losses from underlying protocols
winners.additionalInfo:
Hackathon sprint achievements:

 1. Protocol design & math finalized and tested
 2.  >12k lines of Rust code, finished the main Kormos Vault contract 
 3. UI MVP ready, started integrating with protocol

winners.name: Cloak | Solana Privacy Layer
winners.description:
Privacy has become the last missing piece of the Solana ecosystem and Cloak is here to fill that gap.

Private payments on Solana: deposit from one wallet, withdraw to different ones, and the link between them is hidden. Miners secure and maintain the network’s privacy by submitting valid work and generating transaction volume, ensuring that activity never depends solely on user traffic. On-chain, the network only sees “pool → recipient,” never “sender → recipient,” while every new deposit and mined withdrawal expands the overall anonymity set.

Cloak keeps the system running smoothly and decentralized — users transact privately, miners earn rewards, and Solana stays fast and transparent where it matters.
Solana-native • mobile-friendly and soon on dApp Store • fully open-source • built during Cypherpunk + IslandDAO.

- Go to `Settings` -> `Clusters` -> `Create` and add this Mainnet connection

Unlike traditional DEXs that require risky migrations from bonding curves to liquidity pools, FEELS implements a unified market architecture where a single protocol-owned liquidity pool serves three functions simultaneously:

1. Spot Trading (Phase 1)

The foundation is an AMM with protocol-owned liquidity that cannot be withdrawn by any party. The critical innovation is a mathematical price floor: floor_price = protocol_reserves / circulating_supply. This guarantees every holder can always exit at minimum the floor price. As trading fees accumulate in the protocol reserves, the floor continuously rises - making rugs mathematically impossible. Yield sources for the rising floor are accrued AMM fees, yield bearing SOL (e.g. jitoSOL) and protocol-owned MEV capture.

2. No-Liquidation Lending (Phase 2)

The same unified pool extends to lending without requiring separate liquidity. Users can borrow against their FEELS positions, but here's the breakthrough: there are no liquidations. Because the protocol knows the exact floor price and owns all liquidity, it can manage lending capacity dynamically. You borrow against a position that has a guaranteed minimum value - if the price falls, borrowing capacity adjusts, but you never get liquidated and lose your tokens.

3. Natural Leverage (Phase 3)

Leverage emerges organically from the unified pool. Users can take leveraged positions where the collateral base is the same protocol-owned liquidity backing everything else. Funding rates arise naturally from market skew (long vs short imbalance). Even in leverage, the floor price acts as a safety net preventing cascade liquidations that plague traditional perp DEXs.

Why Unified Matters

Traditional DeFi is fragmented: spot liquidity lives separately from lending pools which are separate from perp exchanges. This creates:
  - Capital inefficiency (same dollar locked in multiple places)
  - Migration vulnerabilities (moving from bonding curve to DEX)
  - Liquidation cascades (one system doesn't know the other's state)

FEELS solves this by having one source of truth: the protocol-owned pool. Everything - spot, lending, leverage - operates on the same mathematical foundation with the guaranteed floor as the bedrock.
